note: The supplied datasets contain trajectories but no traffic-light phase labels. These are inferred phase structures, not measured signal programs.

uncertainty: The phase boundaries are inferred from recurring traffic activity and may shift because queues and travel times smear the transition.
Turn movements with weak sample counts can be assigned to no stable phase.
The supplied analysis had a weaker phase ground truth than a signal-controller log, so protected turns and short transition intervals remain unresolved.
The 100 s cycle was previously inferred from traffic periodicity; it is not a directly observed signal timing.
